item.title: U.S. and Iran locked in stalemate as 60-day window for talks expires
item.description: The 60-day deadline for the U.S. and Iran to reach a wider peace deal and to reopen the Strait of Hormuz expires Monday, with no deal in sight.

item.title: Thousands waiting for help as Indonesia earthquake death toll nears 70
item.description: Thousands of people are still waiting for aid on Indonesia's Flores island days after a powerful earthquake killed at least 68 people.

item.title: Tropical Storm Lala drenches Hawaii as flash floods sweep away Big Island homes
item.description: Lala was weakening but still packing a punch as it moved away from the islands, forecasters said.

item.title: Trial starting after Microsoft exec's alleged murder-for-hire involving ex-wife
item.description: Jared Bridegan was repeatedly shot outside his vehicle while his 2-year-old child was strapped in a car seat.

item.title: U.K. prime minister messages with impersonator of top Trump staffer
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham exchanged messaged with someone pretending to be White House chief of staff Susie Wiles.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, known for "Heroes" and "Remember the Titans," dies at 36
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in "Remember the Titans" as a child actor and rose to fame in the sci-fi series "Heroes," has died at the age of 36.

item.title: Trump orders Pentagon to "substantially reduce" military exercises with South Korea
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that the joint military exercises with South Korea are costly and they "send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea.

item.title: CENTCOM chief visits USS Abraham Lincoln amid morale concerns
item.description: Meanwhile, Israel is being condemned by Lebanese leaders for strikes in the south that killed at least 11 people, including children.

item.title: U.S. tourist reportedly killed by lightning strike on Italy's Mount Etna
item.description: An American man hiking up Italy's active Mount Etna volcano was killed by a lightning strike, the national news agency ANSA reports.

item.title: RFK Jr.'s hunt for autism culprits stalls amid Trump's baseless vaccine order
item.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s closed-door research has yet to produce evidence linking vaccines and autism.

item.title: 100-year-old grandmother skydives in California: "If you slow down, life is over"
item.description: Ruby McNally is 100 years old, and she is leaping into the next century of life by skydiving, saying, "There's nothing to be scared of." Ashley Sharp has the story.

item.title: Hollywood makes dazzling comeback with $5 billion blockbusters this year
item.description: The box office has been booming in 2026, with five blockbuster hits making over $1 billion. Mark Strassmann has more details from Los Angeles.

item.title: CBS News poll on whether Democrats split over socialism
item.description: Americans think more young people in office would make politics better.

item.title: Tommy John, MLB All-Star pitcher who had a surgery named after him, dies at 83
item.description: One of Tommy John's biggest legacies to MLB was his comeback elbow reconstruction surgery that now bears his name.

item.title: Tommy John, known in baseball as the "bionic man," dies at 83
item.description: Tributes poured in on Sunday for Tommy John. The baseball legend known as the "bionic man" has died at age 83. Shanelle Kaul reports from Yankee Stadium.

item.title: Europe endures its fifth heat wave this summer, 50% of continent in a drought
item.description: Europe has been sweating through its fifth round of dangerously high temperatures since May. Ramy Inocencio is in London with more.

item.title: Majority of Americans not satisfied with U.S. economy, CBS News poll finds
item.description: A new CBS News poll found 69% of Americans are not satisfied with how the economy is working. With the Iran war in its sixth month, there's still pain at the pump. Aaron Navarro has more.

item.title: Hurricane Lala hits Hawaii, weakens to tropical storm
item.description: The Big Island of Hawaii was sideswiped by Hurricane Lala this weekend. While it avoided a direct hit, the governor said at least 100 homes were damaged or lost. Lala is now a tropical storm, but the danger is not over for the island chain. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

item.title: Nearly 1,000 aftershocks followed Indonesia earthquake that killed at least 53
item.description: With magnitudes of 7.7 and 6.4, two earthquakes struck different parts of Indonesia on the same day. Authorities have since recorded at least 995 aftershocks.

item.title: What inspired the outfits in Margaret Atwood's "The Handmaid's Tale"
item.description: In an interview with 60 Minutes correspondent Jon Wertheim, author Margaret Atwood joked about the signature red cloak and bonnet: "Well, if you have a cult, and if you have totalitarianism, you have to have outfits."

item.title: The anatomy of a Mardi Gras showdown
item.description: In the Mardi Gras Indian, or Black Masking Indian, tradition, the big chiefs and their crews — spy boys, flag boys, wild men and a big queen — square off in mock battles with other so-called tribes to determine who is, in their words, the "prettiest."

item.title: Veteran faces childhood trauma on psychedelic journey
item.description: Navy veteran Michael Giardina told Anderson Cooper he was able to "let go" of trauma from his childhood during a psychedelic experience.

item.title: 8/16/2026: A Psychedelic Journey; The Mardi Gras Indians; The Indomitable Margaret Atwood
item.description: First, U.S. veterans with PTSD take a psychedelic journey in Mexico. Then, a look at the Mardi Gras Indians keeping tradition alive. And, Margaret Atwood: The 60 Minutes Interview.

item.title: 8/16: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Lala drenched Hawaii in three feet of rain; death toll rose to seven from Midwest flooding.

item.title: Beshear says he's "heard absolutely nothing" from McConnell
item.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear said he hasn't heard back from Sen. Mitch McConnell following formal requests for an update on his health last month amid a weekslong hospitalization.

item.title: Rahm Emanuel on Trump, the left, and what's right for America
item.description: As a Democratic Congressman, Chicago mayor, ambassador, and chief of staff in the Obama White House, Rahm Emanuel has been a key and combative moderate; he says his fight, now and in the future, is bigger than him and his party.

item.title: A summer of extremes: Weathering a hotter world
item.description: July was the hottest month ever in the Lower 48 States – another escalation of our world into a hotter, more dangerous planet, where extreme weather events – such as heat waves, wildfires and hurricanes – will become more common and more extreme.

item.title: American Kate Douglass sets 50-meter freestyle world record at Pan Pacific
item.description: Kate Douglass, 24, is a five-time Olympic medalist.

item.title: Air traffic controller saves day when 2 jets with same call number converge
item.description: An air traffic controller's quick thinking helped avert a dangerous situation when two jets, one landing in Phoenix and the other simultaneously taking off, shared the same flight number and radio frequency.

item.title: State Police investigators testify about search history in Lindsay Clancy trial
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's trial for the murders of her three children in Massachusetts resumed Thursday with testimony from State Police investigators.
